08 · 8 resources

WebRTC fundamentals

WebRTC is the default transport for voice agents that don't run over the phone network. Understanding ICE, STUN, TURN, and SFU architecture is non-negotiable for production work.

Suggested learning path: Week 1: Foundations

8 resources

  • MDN WebRTC APIdeveloper.mozilla.org

    Authoritative free reference for RTCPeerConnection, getUserMedia, and signaling.

    Beginner
  • MDN: Introduction to WebRTC Protocolsdeveloper.mozilla.org

    Beginner-friendly explanation of ICE, STUN, TURN, and SDP.

    Beginner
  • WebRTC.org Getting Startedwebrtc.org

    Official Google-maintained intro, splitting WebRTC into media-capture and connectivity.

    Beginner
  • GetStream: WebRTC for the Bravegetstream.io

    Free multi-module tutorial covering networking basics through advanced topics.

    Beginner
  • Why WebRTC Beats WebSockets for Voice AI (LiveKit)livekit.com

    2025 explainer aimed at AI builders, comparing transports in plain English.

    Intermediate
  • Daily Docs: Intro to Video Architecture (P2P vs SFU)docs.daily.co

    One of the clearest beginner write-ups of P2P vs SFU.

    Beginner
  • P2P, SFU, MCU, Hybrid: WebRTC Architecture Guide (Forasoft)forasoft.com

    Vendor-neutral 2026 breakdown of the four architectures with current OSS tooling (mediasoup, Janus, Jitsi).

    Intermediate
  • Agora: How WebRTC Worksagora.io

    Side-by-side WebRTC vs WebSockets walkthrough with signaling diagrams.

    Beginner
